lines.text: The Titanic is sinking. And I am still on board.
My part is made up. Everything around me is true.
The lifeboats are gone. About 1,500 of us are left.
lines.say: The lifeboats are gone. About fifteen hundred of us are left.

lines.text: Distress rockets burst over the ship, one after another.
The bow goes under. The sea comes up the deck.
At 2:20 in the morning, the Titanic is gone.
lines.say: At two twenty in the morning, the Titanic is gone.

lines.text: I swim for an overturned lifeboat. About thirty men cling to it.
At about four, a ship arrives: the Carpathia.
lines.say: At about four, a ship arrives. The Carpaythia.

lines.text: She saves about 700 people. About 1,500 are lost.
lines.say: She saves about seven hundred people. About fifteen hundred are lost.

lines.text: I survived the Titanic. Most did not.
